title: Office networks
emptyDescription: Add the allowed office IP ranges.

dialog.description: Enter a name and the IP range (CIDR) of the office network.
dialog.detectHint: Press “Detect” while on the office network — the field will be filled in automatically.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this network?
deleteDialog.head: The network
deleteDialog.tail: will be removed. Employees on this network will no longer be able to check in by IP.

footnote: QR check-in only works from allowed networks. If the list is empty, the network check is off.
